svg.text: Before / after comparisons from the retrieval + generation experiment framework (eval/experiment.py)
retrieval_mode: dense → hybrid (BM25 + Reciprocal Rank Fusion)
Broad win — every retrieval metric improves, no added latency
Best single ranking gain in the suite — at a real latency cost
top_k=5 · dense retrieval · 15% overlap, both sizes
larger chunks → more prompt tokens per query
Regression — larger chunks dilute retrieval precision here
dense retrieval, no reranker — ordinal comparison
Diminishing returns — wider top_k buys little recall at real cost
Retrieval deltas are directionally consistent with this repo's real, measured Phase 4 battery (experiments/, docs/PHASES.md).
⚠ SIMULATED EXAMPLE RESULTS — generation/cost/latency figures illustrate a full run against a live LLM provider; none were produced by a real API call.
